newsitem.title: TURKEY: Five prisoners die in Turkish prison riot.
newsitem.headline: Five prisoners die in Turkish prison riot.

text.p: Five Turkish prisoners died in a riot at a jail in Istanbul over poor conditions and treatment, hospital officials said on Wednesday.
"At the moment there are five dead and five injured in our hospital," an official at the Sagmalcilar hospital told Reuters. The riot took place on Tuesday.
Inmates took a warden hostage and set fire to their cells at Istanbul's Metris prison on Tuesday night, prompting intervention by gendarmerie police, Anatolian news agency said.
The rioters were jailed for criminal offenses and had no political demands, the agency said.
"I listened to their requests. They said they wanted better treatment and conditions," Anatolian quoted Istanbul governor Ridvan Yenisen as saying after visiting the prison.
Police and ambulances were standing by outside the jail, which holds 1,200 people despite being built for only 700 inmates.
